text: Good App, although it needs to have a feature to select the date that you quit something.
author: IAMCOCO
developer_reply: Thank you for the kind words and the suggestion! You're right picking your quit date when adding a habit would be really useful, especially if you're switching from another tracker. It's on our list for an upcoming update. Thanks for helping us make the app better!

text: I like how simple this app is, and the new panic button update is great. Got me through some harsh times. I haven't made it to my 1 year goal yet, but I hope I'll get there. At 19 days now .
author: Nadia Szelag
developer_reply: Thank you so much! This made our day. 19 days is real progress, and every one of them counts. The panic button exists for exactly those harsh moments, so we're glad it helped. One day at a time, and that 1-year goal will come. We're rooting for you! 💪
